candidates.storyHeadline: Royals add RHP Bastardo in trade with Red Sox
candidates.text: As @francysromero.bsky.social is reporting, the Red Sox are trading RHP Angel Bastardo to the Royals. In exchange, they’ll get minor league IF Jack Pineda, a 27-year-old who hit .351/.413/.530 in Double-A and Triple-A last year.

candidates.storyHeadline: Royals add RHP Bastardo in trade with Red Sox
candidates.text: We have acquired RHP Angel Bastardo from the Boston Red Sox for INF Jack Pineda. Bastardo has been added to the 40-man roster, which now includes 39 players.
